title: Construct local polymer weights without a global syndrome oracle
statement: Successful local RX fills and RZ parity lifts, together with the constant seed image test, prove forward AND converse admission for every valid syndrome. Histories are unique, binary and zero-preserving; each connected component is separately admitted and compatible unions are admitted. There is no decoration multiplicity; history weight<=4 top weight.

requires: Actual all-level local syndrome predicates, redundant parity relations, exact corrected logical algebra and rational beta=4 ln B0
Fixed sufficiently strong polymer decay; for the stronger rooted engine B0>=Abar^4
Trusted ideal preparation/reset/control and paid local sparse-address arithmetic
provides: Successful local RX fills and RZ parity lifts, together with the constant seed image test, prove forward AND converse admission for every valid syndrome. Histories are unique, binary and zero-preserving; each connected component is separately admitted and compatible unions are admitted. There is no decoration multiplicity; history weight<=4 top weight.
assumptions: This improves the prior exponential proposal bound for ideal NOMINAL initialization. It does not initialize the noncommuting clock-gadget Gibbs environment, handle unknown charged errors or noisy preparation, or give a worst-case log(1/epsilon) runtime bound. Rare long rooted proposals remain; a cap restores a separate polynomial 1/epsilon guarantee. The ordinary all-zero approximation already meets the finite n1336, epsilon .01 example.
costs: O(n) bounded-degree history variables; connected-set enumeration/cutoffs or rooted proposals
Expected work is distinct from worst-case/high-probability work; no runtime-conditioned restart
Preparation channel diamond <=2 epsilon, plus all actual physical-control and storage costs
